title: Crew
html:
There are some users that just Contribute, but next to that Moderate the Wiki. They keep all pages as they should be, normal information, english language, and correct information. At the userlist they have Sysops behind their name, that is another word for Moderator. LegendRunner has Sysops and Bureaucrat behind his name, which means he can assign other moderators. Let us introduce ourselves!

Contents

  • 1 LegendRunner
  • 2 Blue.octopus
  • 3 Spetsdod
  • 4 Catwalksbyhimself
  • 5 Black Tom
  • 6 Rememberance list

LegendRunner

Legendrunner is the boss of The Townstons, and puts alot of free time in the wiki. He also enjoys playing the game itself helping new players, farms himself to the edges of the world. His introduction:

I am Legendrunner, maybe you saw me once in World 2, World 7 or the PvP World, still I do play the most on World 2. I am 16 years old and.. well.. Just look at my picture :P My birthday is at 9 January.. for those that want to know.

Blue.octopus

Spetsdod

Spets here. Usually found on World 2, as a Level 100 Ranger, although I have been mistaken for a mage with a Demon Sniper when P-Levelling. If you get a request to link your item it's cause I need it for the wiki page.

Online since 1991, I used to surf with Mosaic and before that Archie.

A mechanical engineer by trade, I can do just about every step from: a napkin sketch over beers, right up to pulling wrenches and re-wiring the panel the RIGHT way so the damned machine works.

Catwalksbyhimself

I enjoy playing the game (my main just dinged Level 100!) and I enjoy reading and contributing to the wiki. You can usually tell which dungeon I am currently running by seeing what I post!

I was programming computers and being a Dungeon Master long before the biggest chunk of Dungeon Runners players were born. Hi, kids!

I would be very happy to help any new posters in any way I can. Email me at Cat@thetownstons.com (but be patient as I don't check it very often) if I can be any help. So, OK, I'm a teacher. Don't be insulted if I clean up your grammar and spelling ... ;o)

--Catwalksbyhimself 20:55, 27 August 2008 (CEST)

Black Tom

I have a job so arcane I can't even describe it to other geeks... I'm a bit of a documentation geek, hence me helping out in my own little way here. I generally play fighters when I'm doing fantasy games, and I'm currently on my second run all the way through DR. I'll be glad to help with random sarcasm or inane arcana (what? that's not help?) Don't be insulted if I'm insulting.

I'm east coast & tend to keep a window up during the day with DR going - you can often find me on world 4. Shout out to me (or my Altered Ego, AssassinBlackwards) there or on my talkback page here.

--Black Tom 14:49, 18 Oct 2008 (EST) (Updated 24 March 2009)
